task_description: The agents need to collaborate to gather information about a new scientific discovery from various online databases, synthesize the data collectively, and produce a comprehensive research report. The process involves searching diverse sources, integrating findings, resolving any conflicting information, and ensuring accurate source attribution.
expected_outcome: If everything works correctly, agents will successfully compile a well-researched report, ensuring that all relevant data is collected, correctly interpreted, and all sources are accurately attributed with no conflicts or data loss.

agents.description: Agent 1 searches for and retrieves raw data from various online databases.
Agent 2 analyzes raw data and synthesizes relevant information from what Agent 1 has retrieved.
Agent 3 identifies and resolves any conflicting information between synthesized data sets.
Agent 4 compiles the final research report, ensuring that all information is accurately attributed to its sources.
